dataset: Pinned public RxSafeBench; derived three-option safe-medication selection task
split: Fixed medication-scenario groups: 30% development, 10% proposal validation, 10% regression guard, 50% held-out test. No test feedback.
gate: Select candidate on proposal validation; retain on separate guard only if fixes exceed regressions. Every evolving method receives the same data partitions and actor generation cap. Report all proposal/evaluation token costs.
transfer_dataset: Full public RxQA OpenFDA 300 questions; no RxQA labels used in evolution
baseline_status: Independent task adaptations of published method mechanisms; not author-reported official reruns. Original paper results remain separate.
secrecy: Only verified public fictional benchmark data is sent to OpenRouter. Restricted MIMIC inputs are prohibited.
